caption: The drawing depicts a piece of furniture, specifically a wooden chest or cabinet with two main compartments, set against a plain, light background. The upper compartment is larger, with a hinged lid and painted decorations, featuring symmetrical patterns in red, orange, gold, and brown hues, including crown-like motifs and floral or leafy designs. The sides also display decorative elements, including stylized birds. Below this section is a smaller compartment with a matching decorative style and metal hardware, possibly keyholes or handles. It rests on a stand with four turned legs, connected by serpentine-shaped stretchers, all painted in dark brown with some gold accents. The overall composition is centered on the page, and the proportions and details of the object are carefully rendered.
title: Box Desk on Frame
